title: Eliot Wolf on Christian Gonzalez: "Each side is trying to do what's right for them"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eliot Wolf on Christian Gonzalez: "Each side is trying to do what's right for them"
sources.description: When the Falcons signed running back Bijan Robinson to a new contract, the Lions and running back Jahmyr Gibbs used the Robinson deal as the template for quickly getting their own contract done.
